purpose: Check the complete bilingual teacher-facing comparison layer for wording and evidence problems after revised-PEP sequence verification.

checks.test: No promotional positioning, product hype, sales slogans or AI-style filler in teacher-facing comparison records.
No record treats matching grade/year numbers as automatic curriculum equivalence.
Statutory English curriculum is described as England, not as a single UK primary curriculum.
Common Core is not described as the single nationwide US curriculum.
PEP placement follows the verified revised 12-volume sequence and does not use legacy units as current.
checks.notes: Exact grade/semester/unit may now be shown from the authoritative revised-series table. Below-unit detail retains its separate evidence status; locality rollout is not inferred.

checks.test: Curriculum/guidance evidence is not converted into claims that all teachers in a country routinely use a particular method or representation.
Earlier/later placement is not presented as better/worse.
High-risk translation terms follow the terminology glossary.
notes: bar model remains 条形模型（bar model） rather than being silently equated with 线段图.
Common Core line plot is explicitly distinguished from 折线统计图 / line graph.
England Year N and Common Core Grade N remain jurisdiction-specific labels.
fluency is treated as mathematical fluency/熟练度, not speed alone.

checks.test: Frameworks without a formal primary probability strand are not given invented standards.
China primary circle/transformations content is not forced into unsupported Common Core Grades 1-6 equivalents.
Verified revised-series design is not described as nationwide/locality-specific classroom use without rollout evidence.

ongoing_rules: Run this audit again whenever teacher-facing comparison copy is materially changed.
A wording audit does not replace source verification; source-status gates remain authoritative.
New copy must use the bilingual terminology, grade-resolution and PEP rollout rules.
